left = PhysicalPipeline("Reviews.csv", reviews)
left.filter(lambda r: r.get("idx") == "ant_man_and_the_wasp_quantumania")
left.sem_map(
    [{"name": "sentiment", "type": "str", "description": "Overall sentiment of the review. Output exactly one word: positive or negative."}],
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
)
left.project(["idx", "reviewId", "sentiment"])

right = PhysicalPipeline("Reviews.csv", reviews)
right.filter(lambda r: r.get("idx") == "ant_man_and_the_wasp_quantumania")
right.sem_map(
    [{"name": "sentiment", "type": "str", "description": "Overall sentiment of the review. Output exactly one word: positive or negative."}],
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
)
right.project(["idx", "reviewId", "sentiment"])

pipeline = left.sem_join(
    right,
    condition="These two reviews express the same sentiment, meaning both are positive or both are negative.",
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    join_parallelism=20,
)
pipeline.filter(lambda r: r.get("reviewId") != r.get("reviewId_right") and str(r.get("reviewId")) < str(r.get("reviewId_right")))
pipeline.project(["idx", "reviewId", "reviewId_right"])
